result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors. The change is one edit in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java`, in `getAllTeams()`.

- A contributor goes into the remainder only if they matched no configured team and are active. Active means `isActive()` is true, or the latest-commit date is blank.
- Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.
- Configured teams are unchanged and keep all members, active or not.

The codeanalyzer module builds and all 330 tests pass (3 skipped). There are no landscape-specific tests in the module, so the new filter itself is not covered by a test. I did not add one, and I did not run the report generation end to end. Nothing is committed.
